incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INFR-EU-FANOUT (1768454322)
incident-bot: Trigger: embeddings-queue latency spike >500ms and rising 5xx rate. Affected: eu-west. Auto-escalation: Lee (oncall)
Lee (oncall): Ack'd in PD, I'm on it. Pulling the quick runbook and current graphs.
Maria: Thanks — any immediate customer impact we should flag to CS?
Lee (oncall): Early notes: tail latencies up to ~10-30s for a small subset, about 0.6% of requests returning transient errors. Investigating queue depth, autoscaler decisions, and cache evictions.
Jamal: I can already see a hot-shard pattern on kvcache, eviction churn looks correlated with spike. Will try a sticky policy for hot prefixes.
Alex: If you need to bump dedicated capacity, what's the safe command?
Lee (oncall): Runbook snippet I'm about to use:
```
# scale dedicated pool minimal step to avoid thundering
rdctl pool scale --pool eu-embed --replicas +2 --reason "pd-fanout-1768454322"
```
Lee (oncall): Planning +2 first, wait 90s, then reassess. Maria, please hold on external comms until we confirm improvement.
Maria: Will stand by. If you want, I'll prepare a short status template for CS (one-paragraph, ETA 30m).
Jamal: Applied sticky kv policy for hot keys (10m window) to reduce eviction churn:
```
eval-tool set-kvcache --pattern "cust:*:embed" --policy sticky --ttl 600
```
Jamal: Policy applied. Monitoring evictions now — initial drop visible.
pagerbot: PD reminder: escalation to SECOps in 8 minutes if no progress noted.
Lee (oncall): Kicking the scale +2 now. Watching PU (pods up) and 5xx rate.
Alex: Recommend staggering when scaling more than +3 to avoid warmup spikes.
Lee (oncall): After +2, median latency down to ~280ms, p95 ~1.1s, 5xx count trending down. Good signal.
Maria: Nice. When can we tell affected customers?
Lee (oncall): Suggest a short note: "We saw brief elevated latency in EU affecting a small subset; services are stabilizing; full remediation ETA 30m." Maria, ok to send?
Maria: Drafting now, will route to Legal & CS for a quick look, then send.
Jamal: I'll leave the sticky kv policy in place for 20m then revert unless thrash returns.
Lee (oncall): I'll keep monitoring for 30 minutes. If stable, I'll handoff to Alex at 1768455200. Staying on-call until then.
Alex: Happy to take handoff later. Thanks for the quick fix.
Maria: Sent CS note and customer-facing blurb. Added link to status page.
incident-bot: Reminder: add incident notes and runbook ticks. If >30m customer impact or manual mitigations applied, please file a postmortem.
Lee (oncall): Adding temporary mitigations to incident log and marking for postmortem. Closing PD after stability window.
